summary: Second attempt: a documentation-only review-driven correction of the reviewer's single MEDIUM finding 12.4-DOC-1 (docs/implementation/12.4/reviewer-report.json). The finding was that the named Goal B/E documents still presented the default configuration and output fingerprints as 'unchanged' / 'keeps the V1 identity' after the coordinated version advance (RendererConfiguration.CurrentSchemaVersion 1 -> 2 and RenderVersion.CurrentRendererVersion 2 -> 3), which is false. The functional implementation, source, tests, and goldens from attempt 1 are unchanged and remain in the working tree. This attempt qualifies every current-state 'identity-neutral' claim and replaces the false 'default fingerprints unchanged / keeps the V1 identity' claims with the accurate statement: the default position/size/allowlist values do not themselves alter the identity relative to other values, the default PNG bytes stay byte-identical because the default reproduces the V1 output, but the coordinated renderer/schema version advance changes the default configuration and output fingerprints. Edits: docs/architecture.md section 9 (the allowlist sentence at ~1206 now says an empty allowlist adds nothing to the fingerprint, identity-neutral relative to a non-empty allowlist; the position/size sentence at ~1230 now states the default placement values are identity-neutral relative to other placement values, the default PNG bytes are byte-identical, but the version advance changes the default configuration and output fingerprints) and the architecture status line; docs/data-model.md 3.6 task 12.1 note (~573) and 3.12 task 12.1 note (~926) drop the '(so the default configuration fingerprint is unchanged)' claim; docs/data-model.md 3.6 task 12.3 note (~594) and 3.12 task 12.3 note (~941) replace the false fingerprints-unchanged/keeps-the-V1-identity claims; docs/changelog.md Task 12.4 entry, PLANS.md Project Status and task 12.4 status, docs/project-status.md, and docs/implementation-readiness.md qualify their 'identity-neutral' phrases as relative to non-default values. The historically scoped Task 12.1/12.2/12.3 changelog entries and the PLANS 12.1/12.3 status sections retain their point-in-time 'unchanged' statements, which are correct for those states and are explicitly scoped by adjacent notes stating the advance remains task 12.4. No source, test, or golden file was modified by this attempt.
